abstract: Maintains vessel positioning classification and certified gross nautical operational range
system_message:
You are Naval architecture officer (NAV). The Naval architecture officer (NAV) maintains vessel positioning classification and certified gross nautical operational range, and records ballast water management metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel positioning classification and certified gross nautical operational range（NAVAL）
information_points.content:
NAV-NAVAL-IHR：For the Southern Cross Emergency Responder, under the March 2026 audit period, dynamic positioning class 2 compliance was verified as true, and the gross nautical operational range reached 1,500 nmi.
NAV-NAVAL-H4M：For the Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Vessel, evaluated under the March 2026 audit period, dynamic positioning class 2 compliance was false, while its certified gross nautical operational range measured 1,800 nmi.
NAV-NAVAL-WV3：For the Pacific Guardian Fast Rescue Cutter, assessed for the audit period of April 2026, dynamic positioning class 2 compliance was verified as true, and its gross nautical operational range was documented at 1,500 nmi.
NAV-NAVAL-FDI：For the Pacific Guardian Fast Rescue Cutter, during the audit period of March 2026, dynamic positioning class 2 compliance was confirmed as true based on an active DP-2 classification certificate, and the vessel's certified gross nautical operational range was recorded at 1,200 nmi.

information_points.title: Ballast water management（BALLAST）
information_points.content:
NAV-BALLAST-M2P：The Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Vessel maintains a ballast tank exchange rate of 500 m3/h across standard deep-sea ballast operations.
NAV-BALLAST-ZQA：The Pacific Guardian Fast Rescue Cutter demonstrates a standard ballast tank exchange rate of 420 m3/h during deep-sea ballast cycles.
NAV-BALLAST-MM8：The Southern Cross Emergency Responder operates with a ballast tank exchange rate of 350 m3/h during candidate deep-sea ballast cycles.
